blocks.tamil_translation: Do not be angry with one another. Do not turn your faces away from one another. While one of you is bargaining, another should not bargain! Become the servants of Allah Ta'ala and behave with brotherly affection. A Muslim is the brother of another Muslim; a brother will not wrong him, (and if anyone else transgresses against him) he will not leave him helpless and without support. Moreover, he will not regard him with contempt. At that time the Prophet ﷺ pointed towards his chest and said three times, “Taqwa (the fear of Allah) is here.' It is enough for a man to be evil that he thinks lowly of his Muslim brother. The blood of a Muslim, his property, and his honour and dignity have been made haram for another Muslim.” Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said this.

blocks.text:
Explanation:- The meaning of what Rasulullah ﷺ said, “Taqwa is here,” is that the fear of Allah Ta'ala is the name for being mindful of the reckoning of the Hereafter. “Taqwa' is an inner state of the heart. Other people cannot see with their eyes and know whether there is Taqwa or not. Therefore a Muslim has no right to regard another Muslim with contempt. Who indeed knows whether the one who is regarded as lowly on the basis of outward appearance may have Taqwa in his heart and be honoured in the sight of Allah Ta'ala?
(Ma'ariful Hadith)

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ اَبِيْ هُرَيْرَةَ ﵁ اَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ قاَلَ: اِيَّاكُمْ وَالْحَسَدَ، فَاِنَّ الْحَسَدَ يَأْكُلُ الْحَسَنَاتِ كَمَا تَأْكُلُ النَّارُ الْحَطَبَ، اَوْ قَالَ: الْعُشْبَ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه ابوداؤد، باب في الحسد، رقم: ٤٩٠٣
